LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: General Etiquette
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you greet your learner should be able to: digital parents/guardians/elders/friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
2. appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
• Model 2: appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
2. Practise: appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for General Etiquette.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you greet your learner should be able to: digital parents/guardians/elders/friends?
2. How do you greet the priest at greetings used at places of the different forms of the place of worship?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
• appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
